class.name: DV_Grid
class.brief_description: Scrollable data grid for tabular datasets with themable rows, column sizing, and hover/click events.
class.description:
DV_Grid renders structured data with a fixed header row and optional keyboard navigation. Configure column names, row data, and per-column widths, or let the grid stretch columns to fill the available space. Theme hooks expose row, selection, and header colors to match the rest of the dashboard.
[codeblocks] [gdscript]
extends DV_Grid
func _ready() -> void: set_columns(["Item", "SKU", "Category", "Location"]) set_data([ ["Wheat Flour", "SKU-1024", "Food", "Aisle A"], ["Steel Nails", "SKU-2048", "Hardware", "Yard"], ]) cell_clicked.connect(_on_cell_clicked)
func _on_cell_clicked(row: int, col: int) -> void: var world_name = get_cell_value(row, 0) print("User selected world: ", world_name) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

constants.constant: No automatic column stretching. Columns use their defined pixel widths.
The last column expands to fill the remaining horizontal space of the grid.
All columns are resized proportionally to distribute the total grid width.

method.name: get_source_row
method.description: Maps a displayed row back to its index in the data passed to [method set_data], which is what [method get_cell_value] expects. Returns [code]-1[/code] if [param visual_row] is out of range.

method.name: sort_by_column
method.description: Sorts by [param col]: [code]1[/code] ascending, [code]-1[/code] descending, [code]0[/code] to restore the original order. Equivalent to clicking the header, but callable from script — useful for restoring a saved sort. Numeric columns sort numerically, not lexicographically. Sorting affects display only; [method get_cell_value] still addresses the source data, so map through [method get_source_row] first.

method.name: get_col_width
method.description: Returns the width in pixels of the column at [param col].

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the row data backing the grid as an array of arrays.

method.name: get_cell_value
method.description: Returns the data stored at the specified [param row] and [param column]. Returns an empty [Variant] if the indices are out of bounds.

method.name: get_row_count
method.description: Returns the number of rows currently loaded.

method.name: set_col_width
method.description: Overrides the width (in pixels) for the given column.

method.name: set_columns
method.description: Sets the header labels and resets the grid layout to match.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Populates the grid with the provided rows. Each row should match the column count.

method.name: set_grid_visible
method.description: Shows or hides grid lines between cells.

method.name: set_header_height
method.description: Sets the height of the header row (in pixels).

method.name: set_keyboard_nav_enabled
method.description: Enables arrow-key navigation between cells when [code]true[/code]. The grid also has to be able to take focus, which it does by default — see [member DVComponent.keyboard_navigable]. Arrows move by one cell, Page Up/Down by a screenful, Home/End to the first and last row, [code]ui_accept[/code] emits [signal cell_clicked], [code]ui_cancel[/code] clears the selection, and Ctrl/Cmd+C copies the selected cell.

method.name: move_selection
method.description: Moves the selection by whole cells [b]in the order the rows are displayed[/b], so a sorted grid moves the way it looks, and scrolls the new selection into view. Returns whether it moved. With nothing selected, the first call selects the top row currently on screen.

method.name: set_selected_cell
method.description: Selects a cell by [b]source[/b] row (the index into the data you set, not the on-screen position), scrolls it into view and emits [signal selection_changed].

method.name: get_visual_row
method.description: Where a source row currently sits on screen, or [code]-1[/code] if it is not in the current order. The reverse of [method get_source_row].

method.name: set_row_height
method.description: Sets the row height for all data rows (in pixels).

members.member: Returns the currently selected cell coordinates as (column, row). A value of (-1, -1) indicates that no cell is selected.
Returns the index of the currently selected row. A value of -1 indicates that no row is selected.
Color of the internal grid lines between cells.
Background color used for the header row.
Overlay color applied to the row under the pointer.
Highlight color used for the actively selected row.
Horizontal padding applied inside each cell (pixels).

How spare width is shared out. [constant STRETCH_PROPORTIONAL] (the default) scales every column by the same factor, so the table fills its space and keeps the proportions the columns already had. [constant STRETCH_LAST] gives all of it to the last column — useful when that column holds a description, misleading when it does not. [constant STRETCH_NONE] leaves the columns at their measured widths.
Whether the arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home/End and [code]ui_accept[/code] move and activate the selection. The grid also has to be able to take focus — see [member DVComponent.keyboard_navigable].

signal.name: selection_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the selected cell changes, by click, by key or by [method set_selected_cell]. [param row] is a source row; it is [code]-1[/code] when the selection was cleared.

signal.name: cell_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when a cell is clicked. Provides row and column indices.

signal.name: cell_hovered
signal.description: Emitted while the pointer hovers a cell.

signal.name: header_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when a column header is clicked. Useful for sorting.
